name: invisible_enemies
description: Second-class entities are never drawn, so they cannot block or be seen, while walls stay solid.
evidence: $23BF xor_draw_lift_or_hazard is the only routine that draws the lift/moth-hazard class, tail-jumping to the XOR renderer with the pointer from $51/$52
update_one_lift_or_hazard and update_lift_and_hazard_group call it once before and once after each move, which with an XOR renderer erases and redraws
obstruction is decided by what is present in the display, so an entity that is never drawn cannot block the player
qualifications: the entities still exist and still move: only their drawing is suppressed, so anything that reads their coordinates rather than the display still sees them
walls and floors are untouched and remain solid
if any entity was already drawn before this takes effect it will never be erased, because erasing is the same call
